<p><strong>Earth System × AI × Interpretability.</strong> I work on water quality prediction, precipitation nowcasting, runoff change, and seasonal sea surface temperature forecasting. My PhD programme is in Computing at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, with joint supervision at EIT, starting September 2026.</p>
<ul class="ql-highlight-metrics">
  <li>Water engineering · Beijing Normal University</li>
  <li>Groundwater science · China University of Geosciences (Beijing)</li>
  <li>Research experience · Southern University of Science and Technology</li>
  <li>Physically interpretable AI for Earth systems</li>
</ul>
